note: 원소 설계표 — 나라(원소) › 가문(물질) › 주민(물건) 세 층. 세계는 판타지·스팀펑크·메카 셋(현대는 일상컷이 맡는다). 사실 칸(elements — 번호·기호·이름·족·주기·분류·상태)은 tools/seed-elements.py 가 채우고, 설계 칸(nations)은 사람이 쓴다. 그림이 잘 나오는 규칙 셋: 주민은 물건 단위(형체 없는 것은 물건으로), 성질은 시각 언어 한 줄로(traits.en), 합성 원소의 판타지는 「예언된 나라」. 규칙은 docs/ELEMENT_CONCEPT.md, 검사는 python3 tools/element-design.py check.

vocab.look_note: 나라 look = 얼굴 여섯(face_shape·eyes·brows·nose·lips·eye_color) + 실루엣 셋(body·hair·hair_color) — 어휘는 lib/look-spec.js VOCAB_EN. 가문 look 은 덮어쓸 것만(보통 hair_color·eye_color), 주민은 가문 것을 물려받는다. 팔레트 색이 머리·눈 색이 된다(사용자 2026-10-30). 세계마다 사람이 달라도 이 성향은 같다 — 생성기 외형 칸에서 직접 고른 값이 이긴다.
vocab.scenes_note: worlds.<세계>.scenes = 그 세계 안의 장소 변주(key·ko·en) — 생성기 「장면」 칸. 비우면(자동) 세계 글의 장소. hold.en = 일상컷에서 손에 들 수 있는 그 원소·물질의 작은 물건(주민은 object.en). 2026-10-30

nations.persona: 도구·무기·다리·기계·피의 원소. 무겁고 땅에 붙어 있고 부지런하며, 천천히 녹슨다. 공업과 전쟁의 대국.

families.persona: 바닷물에서 거둔 소금 — 염전과 밥상의 가문. 염소나라의 소금 가문과 같은 물질, 다른 사람.

traits.ko: 하얀 정육면체 결정, 염전의 흰 바닥
traits.en: white cubic crystals, the white crust of a salt pan, coarse grain and sparkle; the gathered, nourishing side of salt

palette.en: salt white, sea blue, sun gold, wood brown

object.en: a glazed earthenware salt jar with a wooden lid
a salt pan — shallow white basins, a wooden rake, a windmill pump

look.why: salt white → 머리, sea blue → 눈

hold.en: a small wooden salt box with a white crust

look.why: 팔레트의 sodium yellow 가 머리·눈. 물에 닿으면 터지는 불꽃 → 작고 튀는 몸, 양갈래

hold.en: a small jar of cube salt crystals that glows faintly yellow

nations.persona: 부와 영원과 빛의 원소. 녹슬지 않고 변하지 않는다. 따뜻하고 자랑스러운 나라.

ko: 따뜻한 노란 금과 깊은 호박빛 그림자
두드려 편 금박, 박혀 있는 부조
traits.en: warm yellow gold with deep amber shadow, hammered gold leaf and embossed relief, fine stamped borders, permanence shown as an unchanging polish; the element of wealth, permanence and light

palette.en: yellow gold, amber, electrum pale, deep red velvet

fantasy.ko: 황금 왕국 — 금관 신전, 금박 벽, 영원히 꺼지지 않는 황금빛
fantasy.en: a golden kingdom: a temple of beaten gold, gold-leaf walls, a treasury that glows without lamps, dry sunlit hills

scenes.en: inside the temple of beaten gold
in the treasury that glows without lamps
on dry sunlit hills before gold-leaf walls

steampunk.ko: 1849 골드러시 — 광산 수차, 황동 저울, 은행 금고
steampunk.en: around 1849, a gold-rush town: a mine stamp mill and water wheel, brass assay scales, a bank vault with a brass dial, dust and lamplight

scenes.en: by the mine stamp mill and water wheel
at an assay office with brass scales and lamplight
before a bank vault with a brass dial

mecha.ko: 2200 금 접점 반도체 도시 — 회로 금선, 거울 금박 위성
mecha.en: year 2200, a gold-circuit city: gold trace lines running over dark panels, gold-foil satellites and mirrors in orbit, warm hard light
mecha.design: dark armor etched with fine gold circuit lines, gold-plated joints and contacts, a gold-foil mirror disc as a back unit, amber glow lines

scenes.en: on a street where gold trace lines run over dark panels
before a window onto gold-foil satellites and mirrors in orbit
a hall of warm hard light on gold

families.persona: 값을 매기는 가문. 금화와 금괴 — 세상이 처음 금을 돈으로 쓴 리디아에서 왔다.

traits.ko: 둥근 원반, 찍힌 부조, 테두리 톱니
traits.en: round disc shapes, embossed relief (a lion head), fine stamped-edge borders, stacked bars

palette.en: yellow gold, amber shadow, electrum pale, dark velvet

object.en: a stamped gold coin with an embossed lion-head relief and a milled edge

fantasy.en: the Kingdom of Lydia around 600 BC where the first coins were struck: a stone mint courtyard with an anvil die and a furnace, limestone columns, a river with gold sand; a long chiton and himation in gold-dyed linen

object.en: a cast gold bar — a trapezoid ingot with a stamped face

look.why: amber shadow → 눈. 머리는 나라의 golden_blonde 그대로

hold.en: a stack of gold coins

traits.ko: 가는 세공, 알갱이 장식, 보석 물림
traits.en: fine filigree, granulation beads, gem settings, soft gleam against skin

palette.en: yellow gold, rose gold, pearl white, ruby red

object.en: a tall gold crown with tree-branch and antler shapes and hanging jade pendants
a plain gold band ring

look.why: rose gold → 머리, ruby red → 눈

hold.en: a gold ring set with a ruby

look.why: 팔레트의 yellow gold 가 머리·눈. 변치 않는 광택·왕권 → 조각상 같은 키, 올려 묶은 머리, 매부리코

hold.en: a single hammered gold coin

nations.persona: 주기율표 끝의 나라. 만들어진 원자가 다섯 손가락 안이고 1000분의 1초도 못 산다 — 아무도 본 적 없는 원소. 깜빡이며 사라지는 유령 왕국.

ko: 비활성 기체 족의 귀족, 그러나 무거운 고체로 예측됨
traits.en: a synthetic superheavy element that exists for less than a millisecond — only a handful of atoms have ever been made, nobody has ever seen it: it flickers in and out of existence, its edges dissolve into light and scatter as it decays into lighter elements; by position it belongs to the noble-gas royalty (aloof, never mixing) yet is predicted to be a strange heavy solid

palette.en: void black, deep indigo, pale violet-white decay glow, ghostly translucency, a hint of gold for royalty

fantasy.ko: 예언된 나라 — 옛 별지도의 빈칸, 바닥 끝 허공 너머에 생겼다 사라지는 유령 도시, 미완성 별지도 망토
fantasy.en: a prophesied kingdom that does not yet exist — the blank space beyond the last charted country on an ancient star-map: the final tile of a vast mosaic floor that ends in void, a half-formed ghost city flickering into being and dissolving again, towers of violet light and falling ash; an oracle's unfinished star-chart embroidered on her cloak, hems dissolving into drifting motes

scenes.en: on the blank space beyond the last charted country of an ancient star-map
before the final tile of a vast mosaic, the rest complete
at a threshold of a kingdom that does not yet exist, mist and faint light

steampunk.ko: 1869 화학자의 서재 — 황동 주기율표 서랍장, 마지막 서랍만 열린 채 비어 있고 그 유령
steampunk.en: a chemist's study in 1869 — a giant brass periodic-table cabinet filling the wall, drawers marked only by engraved symbols (no readable letters or numbers), most drawers full of glowing vials, the very last drawer at the far corner open and empty, lit from inside by violet light; gaslight, copper pipes, a spectroscope; she is the ghost of that empty drawer, her skirt dissolving into faint violet motes

scenes.en: before the giant brass periodic-table cabinet, drawers marked only by engraved symbols
at the chemist's desk with a lamp, a blank last drawer open
by the study window at night, gaslight below

mecha.ko: 2200 안정의 섬 — 초중량 물질의 검은 수정 도시, 전자껍질 일곱 고리 후광
mecha.en: year 2200, the Island of Stability made real — a stable city of superheavy matter floating in deep space, crystalline black towers lit from within by violet light, a calm nebula sky; she stands firm for the first time, flickering only at the very edges
mecha.design: void-black armor with deep indigo panels, fractured light-lines running across the plates like cracks that leak pale violet glow, parts of the armor phasing translucent as if decaying and re-forming, a halo of seven orbiting shells (electron-shell rings), a gold noble-crest at the collar, hem plates dissolving into drifting motes; the plates must read as solid armor, not a gown

scenes.en: among crystalline black towers lit from within by violet light
at the edge of the Island of Stability, deep space and a calm nebula behind
in a core chamber where matter phases translucent and re-forms

look.why: 팔레트의 pale violet-white decay glow 가 머리(끝이 빛으로 흩어진다)·눈. 비활성 귀족·찰나의 존재 → 길고 가는 몸, 긴 생머리

hold.en: a flickering violet-white mote cupped in her palm, half-dissolving
